::: {#exr-miller-deriv-product-poly-cos}
#### Derivative of a product

Find the derivative of

$$f(x) = (x^4 + 3x^2 + 8)\cos x$$
:::

::: {#sol-miller-deriv-product-poly-cos}
Apply the product rule (@thm-product-rule) with:

$$u(x) = x^4 + 3x^2 + 8, \qquad v(x) = \cos x$$

Their derivatives are:

$$u'(x) = 4x^3 + 6x, \qquad v'(x) = -\sin x$$

By the product rule:

$$\ba
f'(x) &= u'(x)v(x) + u(x)v'(x)
\\
&= (4x^3 + 6x)\cos x - (x^4 + 3x^2 + 8)\sin x
\ea$$
:::
